tool.name: Duplikium
tool.description: Duplikium is a cloud trade copier for MT4, MT5, cTrader and several other platforms. You connect a master account and one or more follower accounts. No VPS install is required.
features: Cloud copier with no local software install
Size settings, symbol filters and pending-order copying
Server locations include Frankfurt, London, New York and Singapore
Prepay by the day, or a monthly subscription, both charged per connected account

plans.name: Subscription
plans.detail: For 1 to 10 accounts. The rate steps down to €6.00 per account per month above 1,000 accounts.

plans.name: Prepay
plans.detail: For 1 to 10 accounts. The rate steps down to €0.20 per account per day above 1,000 accounts.

tool.pricing_note: Per-account prices from the official site on 11 Oct 2026. New signups are offered €30 of credit. Static IP addresses are an optional extra.
